title: 15 August 2010: Paul McCartney live at Wells Fargo Center, Philadelphia
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Wells Fargo Center in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA, on 15 August 2010.

It was the 23rd concert of the Up And Coming Tour, which lasted for 38 dates between March 2010 and June 2011, and the second of two consecutive nights in Philly.

Here’s the performance of ‘Mrs Vandebilt’ from the show:

McCartney had previously performed at the Wells Fargo Center on 16 April 2002 for the Driving World Tour, and 22 and 23 September 2005 for the US Tour. He returned on 21 June 2015 for the Out There Tour.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
